name: Femur
fact: The femur is the bone of the thigh and articulates proximally with the acetabulum.

name: Humerus
fact: The humerus is the bone of the arm, between shoulder and elbow.

name: Sternum
fact: The sternum is the anterior midline bone of the thoracic cage.

name: Deltoid
fact: The deltoid is a major muscle covering the shoulder; its middle fibers abduct the arm.

name: Sciatic nerve
fact: The sciatic nerve arises from the sacral plexus and travels through the posterior thigh.
